title: Jury-of-Judges vs Single Judge: Variance Reduction on a Safety Scoring Task

original_idea.body:
# Jury-of-Judges vs Single Judge: Variance Reduction on a Safety Scoring Task

**Problem:** Recent reliability work suggests panels/juries of diverse LLM judges can outperform a single strong judge when variance and threshold reliability matter, but few safety evals quantify how much a small jury reduces scorer disagreement on harmfulness judgments specifically.

**Direction:** On a public harmful/benign response set with human gold labels, score with (a) each of 3-4 single open judge models and (b) their majority/mean jury. Compare agreement-with-human and variance across reshuffles. Report whether the jury meaningfully cuts the scorer-discrepancy problem and at what category cost.

**Why it matters:** Scorer/autograder unreliability is an explicit open problem (different scorers, different results). A concrete, reproducible measurement of jury benefit on safety scoring gives external evaluators a low-cost reliability upgrade with no training and only small judge models.

**Relevant context:** Judge Reliability Harness: Stress Testing the Reliability of LLM Judges (arXiv:2603.05399). Skewed Score: A statistical framework to assess autograders (arXiv:2507.03772). An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge (arXiv:2506.13639). Overconfidence in LLM-as-a-Judge (arXiv:2508.06225).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (jury reduces scorer disagreement) but jury-of-judges is broadly studied; marginal catastrophic-risk link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Score with several judges + majority/mean, compare to human labels; very accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: jury vs single judge agreement/variance on a labeled safety set.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Externally doable but jury-of-judges is well-trodden; safety-specific quantification adds some value.

low_compute.reasoning: Small judge models on logged responses; cheap.

novelty.reasoning: Jury-of-judges variance reduction is well-studied; safety re-application is incremental.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Jury-of-judges broadly studied; safety-task quantification is incremental.
